text: You're looking for a recipe that fits within your 60-minute time limit and helps you meet your goal of reducing saturated fat. This Mexican-Style Rice (Sopa Seca) recipe meets your time limit, taking only about 30 minutes to prepare [F9, F13]. It also features chicken, which you mentioned you like, and rice, another one of your preferred ingredients [F4, F5]. However, keep in mind that it's also relatively low in protein, which might be a trade-off for you [F11].
